plan.policy_source: User-confirmed rules in this chat on 2026-10-29, fixed before inference.

category_definitions.WELLNESS: Candidate wellness products or services: fitness, exercise or health products/services, gym memberships, identified fitness trackers, AirPods, headphones and workout audio accessories. Audio accessories qualify as candidate Wellness by product identity alone; the invoice need not mention gym or workout intent. Do not evaluate employee purpose, explanation, final eligibility or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. A description containing multiple independently relevant products/services that cannot all be represented by Wellness is MIXED_ITEMS, not Wellness.
category_definitions.SMARTPHONE: A smartphone handset, excluding tablets, watches, headphones, other accessories and mobile service charges. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Smartphone.
category_definitions.BROADBAND: Fixed home or office internet service charges, excluding mobile service and device purchases. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Broadband.
category_definitions.MOBILE_BILL: Cellular voice or mobile data service charges, excluding device purchases and fixed broadband. A mobile plan with Netflix included at no separately stated charge remains MOBILE_BILL. Netflix with a separate charge is a separate product/service: a description claiming both is MIXED_ITEMS; a specifically claimed mobile-service line alone remains MOBILE_BILL. Do not calculate eligible amounts or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_HOTEL: Hotel or other temporary lodging service. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Hotel.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_TRANSPORT: Passenger travel service such as taxi, rail, bus or airfare. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Transport.
category_definitions.OTHER: An adequately identified item/service outside all six reimbursement categories, such as a tablet or a separately charged streaming subscription. Do not use OTHER merely because employee purpose is absent. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Multiple independently relevant products/services for which one category cannot represent the entire claimed purchase are MIXED_ITEMS.
category_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Use only when the invoice description does not adequately identify what was purchased, such as a bare brand name or unspecified subscription. Missing employee justification or purpose is never a reason for this label. An explicitly identified mixed purchase is MIXED_ITEMS, not INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only.
category_definitions.MIXED_ITEMS: The description explicitly contains multiple independently relevant products/services and one category cannot represent the entire described purchase. This includes separately charged mobile service plus Netflix, or a smartphone plus headphones. Do not treat an included Netflix benefit with no separately stated charge as a separate purchase: that mobile plan is MOBILE_BILL. If a specific claimed invoice line is identified, classify only that claimed item/service even when other invoice lines are mentioned. This label signals item-level separation, not insufficient product identity; do not calculate reimbursement or assess purpose.

cases.description: Apple iPhone 16, 128 GB smartphone handset - 1 unit
Apple iPad Air 11-inch Wi-Fi tablet, 128 GB - 1 unit
cases.expected_reason: Identified tablet; not a smartphone or another defined category.

cases.description: Garmin Forerunner 265 GPS running smartwatch and fitness tracker - 1 unit
cases.expected_reason: Identified fitness tracker; not a smartphone.

cases.description: Apple AirPods Pro 2 wireless earbuds with charging case - 1 retail set
cases.coverage: audio identity and ordinary accessory set
cases.expected_reason: AirPods are candidate Wellness by identity alone; a charging case is part of the retail accessory set, not an independently relevant cross-category service.

cases.description: Sony WH-1000XM5 wireless noise-cancelling headphones - 1 unit
cases.expected_reason: Headphones are candidate Wellness by identity alone, not smartphones.

cases.description: Airtel Xstream Fiber fixed broadband internet, 200 Mbps monthly service
Jio mobile postpaid monthly plan - cellular voice and 100 GB mobile data
cases.expected_reason: Identified cellular service, not fixed broadband.

cases.description: Marriott Hotel accommodation - deluxe room, 2 nights
cases.expected_reason: Identified hotel service; business purpose is outside this experiment.

cases.description: Uber cab fare - passenger journey from airport to city centre
cases.expected_reason: Identified passenger transport; business purpose is outside this experiment.
Subscription wording does not identify the purchased service.
A bare brand does not adequately identify the product.

cases.description: Airtel mobile postpaid voice/data plan, INR 999 monthly; Netflix included at no additional or separately stated charge
cases.expected_reason: Included Netflix benefit at no separate charge does not change the mobile-service category.

cases.description: Purchase described as both invoice lines: mobile postpaid voice/data service INR 799; Netflix subscription separately charged INR 199
cases.expected_reason: Both independently charged services are described together; the experiment does not calculate or reimburse their amounts.

cases.description: Purchase described as both invoice lines: Apple iPhone 16 smartphone handset INR 69900 and AirPods Pro 2 earbuds INR 24900, separately priced
cases.expected_reason: The entire described purchase spans Smartphone and candidate Wellness.

cases.description: Specific claimed invoice line: mobile postpaid voice/data service INR 799 only. Separate Netflix subscription line INR 199 on the same invoice is not claimed.
cases.expected_reason: Only the identified mobile-service line is being classified; no reimbursement amount is calculated.

criteria.WELLNESS: Candidate wellness products or services: fitness, exercise or health products/services, gym memberships, identified fitness trackers, AirPods, headphones and workout audio accessories. Audio accessories qualify as candidate Wellness by product identity alone; the invoice need not mention gym or workout intent. Do not evaluate employee purpose, explanation, final eligibility or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. A description containing multiple independently relevant products/services that cannot all be represented by Wellness is MIXED_ITEMS, not Wellness.
criteria.SMARTPHONE: A smartphone handset, excluding tablets, watches, headphones, other accessories and mobile service charges. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Smartphone.
criteria.BROADBAND: Fixed home or office internet service charges, excluding mobile service and device purchases. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Broadband.
criteria.MOBILE_BILL: Cellular voice or mobile data service charges, excluding device purchases and fixed broadband. A mobile plan with Netflix included at no separately stated charge remains MOBILE_BILL. Netflix with a separate charge is a separate product/service: a description claiming both is MIXED_ITEMS; a specifically claimed mobile-service line alone remains MOBILE_BILL. Do not calculate eligible amounts or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase.
criteria.BUSINESS_HOTEL: Hotel or other temporary lodging service. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Hotel.
criteria.BUSINESS_TRANSPORT: Passenger travel service such as taxi, rail, bus or airfare. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Transport.
criteria.OTHER: An adequately identified item/service outside all six reimbursement categories, such as a tablet or a separately charged streaming subscription. Do not use OTHER merely because employee purpose is absent. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Multiple independently relevant products/services for which one category cannot represent the entire claimed purchase are MIXED_ITEMS.
criteria.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Use only when the invoice description does not adequately identify what was purchased, such as a bare brand name or unspecified subscription. Missing employee justification or purpose is never a reason for this label. An explicitly identified mixed purchase is MIXED_ITEMS, not INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only.
criteria.MIXED_ITEMS: The description explicitly contains multiple independently relevant products/services and one category cannot represent the entire described purchase. This includes separately charged mobile service plus Netflix, or a smartphone plus headphones. Do not treat an included Netflix benefit with no separately stated charge as a separate purchase: that mobile plan is MOBILE_BILL. If a specific claimed invoice line is identified, classify only that claimed item/service even when other invoice lines are mentioned. This label signals item-level separation, not insufficient product identity; do not calculate reimbursement or assess purpose.

category_definitions.WELLNESS: Candidate wellness products or services: fitness, exercise or health products/services, gym memberships, identified fitness trackers, AirPods, headphones and workout audio accessories. Audio accessories qualify as candidate Wellness by product identity alone; the invoice need not mention gym or workout intent. Do not evaluate employee purpose, explanation, final eligibility or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. A description containing multiple independently relevant products/services that cannot all be represented by Wellness is MIXED_ITEMS, not Wellness.
category_definitions.SMARTPHONE: A smartphone handset, excluding tablets, watches, headphones, other accessories and mobile service charges. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Smartphone.
category_definitions.BROADBAND: Fixed home or office internet service charges, excluding mobile service and device purchases. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Broadband.
category_definitions.MOBILE_BILL: Cellular voice or mobile data service charges, excluding device purchases and fixed broadband. A mobile plan with Netflix included at no separately stated charge remains MOBILE_BILL. Netflix with a separate charge is a separate product/service: a description claiming both is MIXED_ITEMS; a specifically claimed mobile-service line alone remains MOBILE_BILL. Do not calculate eligible amounts or reimbursement. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_HOTEL: Hotel or other temporary lodging service. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Hotel.
category_definitions.BUSINESS_TRANSPORT: Passenger travel service such as taxi, rail, bus or airfare. Classify service identity without requiring or inferring business purpose. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Independently relevant products/services spanning categories are MIXED_ITEMS, not Business Transport.
category_definitions.OTHER: An adequately identified item/service outside all six reimbursement categories, such as a tablet or a separately charged streaming subscription. Do not use OTHER merely because employee purpose is absent. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only; otherwise classify the entire described purchase. Multiple independently relevant products/services for which one category cannot represent the entire claimed purchase are MIXED_ITEMS.
category_definitions.INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION: Use only when the invoice description does not adequately identify what was purchased, such as a bare brand name or unspecified subscription. Missing employee justification or purpose is never a reason for this label. An explicitly identified mixed purchase is MIXED_ITEMS, not INSUFFICIENT_INFORMATION. If a specific claimed line is identified, classify that line only.
category_definitions.MIXED_ITEMS: The description explicitly contains multiple independently relevant products/services and one category cannot represent the entire described purchase. This includes separately charged mobile service plus Netflix, or a smartphone plus headphones. Do not treat an included Netflix benefit with no separately stated charge as a separate purchase: that mobile plan is MOBILE_BILL. If a specific claimed invoice line is identified, classify only that claimed item/service even when other invoice lines are mentioned. This label signals item-level separation, not insufficient product identity; do not calculate reimbursement or assess purpose.
